counterfactual_missing_items: No specific physical examination findings were reported in the case
decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
response.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results support the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma, with R3 being the more general diagnosis and C1 providing more specific subtype information.

rejected.why: The brain biopsy results do not support Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy, and the absence of EBV/EBER makes this less likely.
The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results do not support Multiple Sclerosis.
The biopsy results do not support Glioblastoma.
